description.value:
Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Trait. Please note that these abilities are incredibly powerful even for the JJK system and should only be used for purposely high power games. Of course, certain traits are stronger than others. Stages of these traits have been added to grow with characters with higher levels of play. Dormant, Stirring, and Awakened. Though a DM can decide to change the leveling format or instead give them out at appropriate character moments.

Whether you were born this way or you somehow gained this form later in life, you have the perfect body for jujutsu.

Extra Limbs. You can use the additional limbs and mouths on your body to make handsigns and chant to activate techniques faster than any normal sorcerer. The action cost of a technique is decreased by one level for you (Full Turn Action > Action > Bonus Action). Additionally, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make an additional melee attack as part of that attack action.

Strong Body. You are one size larger to accommodate the additions to your body, your hit point maximum increases by your level and you gain an additional hit point every time you gain a level.

Natural Weapons. You gain a form of natural weapon you can use to attack, whether they are claws, fangs or some other part of your body. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing on a hit.

Extra Eyes. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Special Trait tiers stack: keep the earlier tiers on the sheet. When a benefit says it replaces an earlier one, the module's effects already account for it.

system.requirements: Must not be a Cursed Corpse; Perfect Form, level 1
